rules.title: Weeks to a working team
rules.text: Your team starts under managed employment while the entity is set up in parallel, so you are not waiting on incorporation to hire.

rules.title: 4 to 6 months to your entity
rules.text: Private Limited incorporation, PAN, TAN, GST, PF, ESIC, banking, statutory auditor: filed in your company's name, then handed over.

rules.title: Break-even at 25 people
rules.text: Past 25 people, entity economics beat managed employment, and the gap widens with every hire.

rules.title: One resident director
rules.text: Indian law requires one India-resident director (182+ days a year). Flexiple provides one during the build and helps you appoint your own.
